headings.description: Used for all dashboard titles, metric cards, and primary headers. Professional, modern, and sharp.

body.description: Used for data tables, form inputs, and general reading. Highly legible for numbers and dense data.

rules: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000. Zinc and Stone provide the slight tint.
Contrast Check: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Normal text min 4.5:1, large text 3:1.
Hover States: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover (e.g. hover:bg-zinc-800 hover:text-white).
DO NOT use teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). 1px subtle borders (border-border/40) for dashboard cards and tables. No heavy shadows, flat backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers or floating navs. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (Light) or bg-zinc-950/70 (Dark) with 1px delicate inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.transparency: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use solid or blurred semi-transparent backgrounds.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.span_logic: Summary metric cards: col-span-1. Main charts: col-span-2 or col-span-3. Feeds/Lists: col-span-1 row-span-2.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards with borders to prevent text collision. Main layout padding p-4 md:p-8.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Paragraphs, labels, inputs, tabular data: Left-align. Numeric data in tables: Right-align. DO NOT center-align the app container.

libraries: shadcn/ui (tables, dropdowns, dialogs, cards, tabs, input, select, forms)
Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards and developer tools
rules: DO NOT use HTML-based components for advanced interactions. Use Shadcn calendar, dropdown-menu, etc.
Go cardless, rectangular, dense styles where possible instead of overusing generic card components.
Customize spacings and radii to match the 8px max radius rule.
Buttons: Modern styles, sharp or slightly rounded, with interaction animations. NEVER pill-shaped for this technical dashboard, stick to rounded-md.
Always include `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case for all interactive/key elements (e.g. `data-testid='login-submit-button'`).

motion.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) for cards, subtle shadow change, border color darkens/lightens.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g. transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NEVER use `transition: all`.
motion.micro_interactions: Smooth state changes for buttons and tabs. Entrance staggered animations for lists and table rows.

accessibility.contrast: Must meet minimum WCAG AA / APCA standards.
accessibility.focus_states: Must have HIGHER contrast than default state (e.g. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500).
accessibility.aria: Add aria-hidden='true' to purely decorative animations/icons.

image_urls.description: Stacked rolled paper tubes. Use as a background or side panel for the Login screen. Apply a heavy overlay (e.g. bg-zinc-900/80) so the login form is readable.
Industrial printing press. Can be used for empty states or placeholder illustrations if needed.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (headers).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-md for this tech dashboard) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Component located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (or similar js path).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
